name: Nattasit Songprawati
source: Jake is a software engineer living in San Francisco. He's married to Dustin, and his best friends are Hannah and Nikhil. He is a huge fan of board games and food of all sorts, and enjoys rhythm games such as Dance Dance Revolution. He tends to get nervous easily around new situations or people, and has trouble making friends on his own.
